description:
Your simple video editor for creating wow videos

Your simple video editor for creating wow videos
- Easily create clips for your socials, business, or family
- Boost your videos with one-click auto subtitles and other AI tools
- Choose from hundreds of titles, transitions, and music tracks
- Add effects and other elements in a click. Dragging and dropping was already easy, but we’ve made it even easier: just hit the plus button on any element card to place it right on your clips. Quick, simple, and works for every type of element.
- The updated Files tab now keeps all your clips and images in one place – no more adding files in one tab and searching for them in another. Everything you import now instantly appears right below the upload area, ready to go.
- Sample clips in Templates now come with a placeholder label, just like Blocks – they show you exactly where to add your footage. Swap, preview, and you’re ready to share.
- Check out the improved Featured tab. Smarter recommendations bring the most popular content to the top, so you can tap into the latest trends and create videos that viewers love to watch.
